title: Color conversion on your product photos
h1: 🎨 Converting the colors of your products
metaTitle: 🎨 Change the color of a photo product in 1 click
description: Generate all your colors in a few clicks thanks to Orbitvu. Save time and harmonize your e-commerce visuals. 💻
tool: Orbitvu photo studio and Orbitvu Station software
introText:
🎨 Change the colors of a product without redoing the whole photo shoot, it is possible. Thanks to the functionality of color conversion integrated into the software Orbitvu Station, all you have to do is Photograph a single variation. The software then allows you to change hue, saturation, and brightness in a few clicks, while maintaining a optimal image quality.

💡 This automated workflow Allows you to save precious time, of reduce production costs and to ensure a homogeneous presentation on all your product sheets.

📊 Whether for online catalogs, of advertising campaigns Or digital showcases, this technology helps you enhance your products while keeping a quick and easy process, accessible even without technical expertise.

🖼 This tutorial was created with the studio Alphashot Pro G2, one of Premiers automated photo studios assisted by AI.

steps.title: Adjust your camera settings
steps.content:
⚙ Adjust your camera's ISOs, aperture, and speed, then adjust the intensity of each LED light source in the studio to get the ideal exposure.

Also, set up the light for theIQ Mask in order to obtain a transparent background.
steps.structuredText: Adjust your camera's ISOs, aperture, and speed, then adjust the intensity of each LED light source in the studio to get the ideal exposure. Also, set the light for the IQ Mask to get a transparent background.

steps.title: Choice of angles for the 360° animation
steps.content:
🔄 Choose the direction of rotation, speed, and number of frames that will make up the 360° animation. For an e-commerce website, for example, specializing in shoes, 24 photos are more than enough.
‍

✅ Start recording the animation
steps.structuredText: Choose the direction of rotation, speed, and number of frames that will make up the 360 animation. For an e-commerce website, for example, specializing in shoes, 24 photos are more than enough. Start recording the animation.

steps.title: Product color change
steps.content:
🎨 Once your animation is captured, go to the color settings in the section Edition.

You can adjust color settings to change the appearance of certain areas of the product by adjusting hue, saturation, or brightness.

You also have the option of selecting a specific color to change. For example, in our case, we chose to change the red part of our cup.

✨tip : if you have made a mistake or want to go back, you can click on the”Reinitialize” to return to the original photo.

faqs.question: Do color changes affect the visual quality of the animation?
faqs.answer: No, color changes are applied accurately and non-destructively, which means that the visual quality of the animation remains intact. The system guarantees smooth and natural transitions between the various shades.

faqs.question: What are the financial advantages of using a variety of colors without retaking a photo?
faqs.answer: By avoiding reshooting for every color variation, you significantly reduce production costs. This allows you to present multiple product combinations quickly, increasing your sales potential without additional effort.

faqs.question: Does the software automatically detect areas that need to be changed when the color changes?
faqs.answer: Yes, the software is equipped with an intelligent color detection tool that makes it easy to select specific areas of the product to be adjusted, without affecting other parts.

faqs.question: Is the software suitable for non-professional users?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Thanks to its intuitive interface and built-in guides, even users with little photography experience can produce professional visuals quickly.

faqs.question: Is it possible to apply the same color settings to multiple products at once?
faqs.answer: Yes, using saved color profiles, you can quickly apply the same adjustments to multiple similar products, ensuring visual consistency and saving time when editing.
